title: Existence of the normalized rational comparison package
statement: For finite-field datum D, coefficient datum c, separated finite-type X₀ and finite E, there exists a `RationalComparison` whose ordinary and completed bifunctors and three isomorphisms satisfy the normalization predicate of [def-wf-tensor-product] and [def-wf-weil-category].

proof.text: Construct the integral ordinary and completed restrictions using [lem-wf-constructible-tensor-koszul-unit], extend their separately linear Hom maps across scalar localization using [def-wf-tensor-product], and localize the unit and pullback comparisons to obtain the normalized package.

proof_origin.place: Rational package existence; named decomposition by U4, 2026-10-28.
